name: 4D Gaussian Splatting (DreamGaussian4D)
definition: A method generating dynamic 4D scenes from single image or video, proposing DreamGaussianHD based on DreamGaussian for image-to-3D initialization, utilizing HexPlane to model Gaussian deformations for realistic motion.
summary: DreamGaussian4D generates dynamic 4D scenes from single images by extending 3D Gaussian Splatting with HexPlane deformations and learning motion from a driving video.
